notes: fixes C-6 not landed: the two protected renderer files own this route. M4-3 is a separate tiled cost, not the cause of the measured direct Fit lag.
summary: With HSL on, Exposure and Contrast drags take +140-290 ms to first feedback at Fit.
evidence: Typical Fit Exposure 32.3→317.8 ms and Contrast 33.3→318.1 ms with HSL on; large Fit 33.9→169.5 and 33.3→170.3 ms. Both measured sessions used gpu-direct. Tone Exposure and Contrast change the pre-HSL RGB tapped by hslFieldsFragmentMain, so the direct prepare key misses. This reruns the fields pass, four preparation dispatches, and three selection dispatches per four channels before a base pass that also executes HSL. Show selection is off for these probes. The trace establishes the work added, not the timing share of each pass.
felt_impact: Noticeable drag lag with an HSL range active.
proposed_fix: Instrument direct selection passes separately. If the repeated pre-HSL prefix is material, prototype reusing that exact stage result in the base pass without an intermediate precision change; requalify pixels and peak memory. Never reuse masks across changed coverage inputs. Changes need coordination in webgpu-preview.js and possibly webgpu-shaders.js.

summary: Tiled HSL rebuilds selection from scratch for every tile even during HSL slider edits that do not change coverage.
evidence: Main and Clarity tile calls pass no prepareKey, unlike the direct route. Each tile encodes the fields pass, four preparation dispatches and three selection dispatches for a one-layer recipe without edge shaping; output storage is overwritten by the next tile.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; highest potential on warm HSL saturation drags forced to tiled rendering. A material gain is plausible if the selection passes dominate, but persistent mask storage could be worse on the Neo.
proposed_fix: Measure the direct and tiled routes separately, then assess bounded visible-tile mask reuse keyed by source generation, upstream grade, region and mask settings. Do not retain full-frame scratch.
check: HSL own Saturation drag at Fit on both photos; add large/100% or forced tiled only if Fit does not exercise it. Compare first feedback, settle and peak memory.
notes: fixes M4-3 not landed: protected renderer file owns tiled scratch and mask lifetime. Reuse only for identical source, tile, upstream and selection inputs; charge retained masks to the existing memory allowance. The measured C-6 Fit drags used direct rendering.

summary: Every native Tone input redraws both highlight graphs and runs unrelated global panel bookkeeping before scheduling a frame.
evidence: Tone range inputs update readouts, derived highlight state and preview generation synchronously. Native drag events share one panel refresh per frame and redraw only the affected highlight graph. Release flushes the final state.
felt_impact: Unmeasured estimate: roughly 5–20 ms of whole first feedback at Fit under dense events, or one missed frame; settle likely little changed.
proposed_fix: Keep slider value/readout synchronous; batch dependent graph and badge updates once per animation frame, flush final values on release, and leave preview invalidation semantics unchanged.
check: Targeted control-panel-values, highlight-delivery-floor, grade-panel-order and film-presets Node tests.

summary: Exposure Bands reconstructs the same interpolation data up to 180 times per slider input and refreshes unrelated controls.
evidence: One prepared interpolation per plot instead of 180. A 16-node run matched the old sampler exactly at all 180 graph positions for each of three smoothing values. The current band readout updates synchronously; plots coalesce and flush on release.
felt_impact: Unmeasured estimate of roughly 3–15 ms of whole first feedback under dense input, most likely noticeable with many bands or if the old handler misses one frame.
proposed_fix: Prepare interpolation coefficients once per graph redraw and coalesce the graph and dependent control refresh to one frame, keeping the final slider state synchronous.
check: Targeted curve-sampling Node tests plus exact old/new graph sample comparison.

summary: Dragging a wheel puck updates every grade control on every pointer move and bypasses the normal gesture pacing.
evidence: Frame-coalesced puck moves touch only the active puck, its fields and tab badge. Pointer release or cancel flushes the most recent move before ending preview interaction. The drag angle, radius and grab offset use the same equations.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; isolated drag gain may be under 15 ms, but with HSL or Denoise stacked, proper pacing could prevent missed feedback during the drag. Test separately from the Blending slider.
proposed_fix: Synchronize only the current wheel fields and modified indicators per frame. Bracket the actual pointer capture lifetime with existing preview pacing, and separately verify single-gesture undo before changing history semantics.
check: Targeted HDR/SDR wheel tests and the Fit audit Shadows puck drag. Stacked HSL and actual History Undo were not separately exercised.
notes: fixes M4-9. History grouping is unchanged.

summary: The picker synchronizes the same global edit state twice before sending one post-release sampling request.
evidence: One save and the edit-command queue fence still precede the picker request. Stopping or rearming still fences a late sample. Save-error text is unchanged.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; likely below the 15 ms audit floor when clean. Retaining one save fence is more important than eliminating this small duplicate.
proposed_fix: Keep one guarded save and revision fence in hslFetchStage; trace whether it saves any actual work first.
check: Targeted HSL picker Node tests verify one save, waiting for queue acknowledgement, coordinates and cancelled samples.

summary: The Vignette outline does layout reads when hidden and rebuilds both paths even when Amount does not change the shape.
evidence: Hidden outlines do not read photo or pane bounds. Visible overlays reposition as needed, but keep the SVG paths until frame dimensions or geometric inputs change.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; likely below 15 ms in isolation, with most potential on repeated visible-overlay Amount moves. No extra preview texture or GPU pass was found.
proposed_fix: Short-circuit hidden state before layout and separate positioning from path updates keyed by the geometric inputs only.
check: Targeted wheel Node test covers hidden layout, unchanged Amount, pan, Midpoint and centre changes.

summary: Active Color recomputes the same primaries matrix even when the changed control cannot affect the matrix.
evidence: One last-value memo reuses the same computed matrix for unchanged hue and purity fields. Sampled full parameter buffers matched the old implementation byte-for-byte. Isolated unchanged-input matrix sampling measured roughly 12–16 to 1–2 μs; no visible gain claimed.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; likely below the audit floor. Only consider if buildParams is hot in a real trace.
proposed_fix: Reuse the exact same computed nine floats for unchanged primaries using a tiny bounded memo or last-value cache. Do not replace it with a different numerical shortcut.
check: Targeted GPU parameter layout Node tests verify exact floats across unrelated edits and repaint-equivalent recomputation when tint hue changes.

summary: Global Show selection repeated CPU and PNG work when its coverage inputs were unchanged.
evidence: The Global overlay now keys on the pre-HSL stage inputs, source and active recipe ranges and edge settings. HSL Saturation, Wheels and Vignette do not submit a redundant request; Exposure or range edits still refresh, and panning out of a cropped mask still requests replacement.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; removing a needless refresh eliminates the whole overlay wait and contention for that edit. For actual range changes the saving is the prepare share plus any obsolete draft still in flight.
proposed_fix: Key refreshes on visible selection inputs, not every grade revision. Reuse prepared data only for the same stage identity, region and scale within the existing memory allowance.
check: Targeted HSL viewport, picker, pacing and resource-lifetime Node tests; Fit audit range-with-selection drag.
notes: fixes M4-4 for no-op Global refreshes. Actual changes still pay preparation. Local HSL retains conservative revision-based refresh.

summary: Actual Global HSL coverage changes still repeat guide preparation when stage and work region have not changed.
evidence: The backend retains the pre-HSL pixels, but each new mask calls prepare, selects, and PNG-encodes. A draft resolution and exact resolution use different preparation; edge shaping may change the processing region.
felt_impact: Unmeasured; removing a needless refresh eliminates the whole overlay wait and contention for that edit. For actual range changes the saving is the prepare share plus any obsolete draft still in flight.
proposed_fix: Measure repeated exact same-stage, same-scale, same-work-region requests. If preparation materially delays feedback, reuse only inside existing stage cache accounting with source, rect and scale fences. Keep Local HSL on the conservative path until its dependencies are proven.
check: Extra HSL own-control probe with Show selection enabled: change Saturation, wheels and Vignette (no request expected); then Range/Feather and Exposure (refresh expected). Compare release-to-exact overlay and the prepare/select/encode breakdown.
notes: fixes M4-4 partially in 073e4aa4. Cache for real coverage changes left open; no extra CPU image arrays retained by O5.
